messages:
amy_csm: Heads-up 11:20 UTC we started getting reports that EU onboarding flows & indexing jobs were returning 5xx for a subset of tenants. Im drafting a short status note for affected customers. Need review and confirmation of remediation/offers.

amy_csm: ```
Subject: Update: EU onboarding and indexing disruption (Mar 22)

Hello,

Were writing to let you know about a technical disruption that affected some EU onboarding and indexing requests earlier today between 11:1811:48 UTC. A portion of onboarding attempts and index writes experienced intermittent failures (5xx).

What happened (brief): a configuration propagation edge case in our auth-sync/control plane caused token validation failures for certain onboarding paths, leading to rejected requests for affected tenants.

Immediate action taken: our engineers identified and deployed a targeted rollback/fix at 11:36 UTC. We reprocessed incomplete indexing jobs and validated successful onboarding flows. Full service has been restored.

Impact: approximately 120 tenants experienced failed onboarding or partial index writes; we do not believe customer data was lost. Where writes were incomplete, we have attempted automated reprocessing.

Next steps: full RCA to be published within 72 hours. Engineering will deliver a permanent fix and deployment gating changes to prevent recurrence.

Support were offering: affected customers will receive one month of account credit. Customers in active renewal discussions will be offered AE-managed timeline extensions and a dedicated remediation meeting. If you used SSO/VPC onboarding flows and still see failures, reply to this message or open a support ticket and well coordinate an on-call engineering replay of your onboarding.

Were sorry for the interruption and appreciate your patience.

Amy, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
```

ben_support: +1 on tone. Suggest small edits: say "we attempted automated reprocessing" -> "we attempted automated reprocessing; if any items remain, we will re-run them with you." Also add a link to status.redwood.ai for realtime updates.

tom_ops: Ops note  incident created INC-20260322-1140 severity P2. Backfill job logs show reprocess window 11:5012:40 UTC.

diego_eng: Root cause summary to include: control-plane retry storm + race on config TTL evaluation produced expired token handoffs for ~3% of EU onboarding requests. Deployed hotfix at 11:36, additional safety rollback at 11:44. Permanent fix (PR + canary + tests) targeted in 72 hours.

diego_eng: Confirm automated backfills completed for 98% of affected writes; remaining ~2% flagged for manual replay.

priya_ae: For renewal-risk accounts: prefer AE-managed remediation rather than blanket credits. Can we add: "Renewals: contact your AE for a tailored remediation plan (extensions, credits, or technical replays)"

amy_csm: Good point. Ill fold that in and make credits opt-out for renewal accounts (AE-managed).

ben_support: Also add a line about SSO/VPC customers: "If you onboarded via SSO/VPC and need an engineering replay, reply here and we will prioritise."

amy_csm: Added both. Final question: credit amt confirmed: 1 month for non-renewal impacted accounts; renewals get AE-managed options. Any objections?

tom_ops: No objections. Log note: billing will apply one-month credit to impacted accounts that don't have an AE remediation flagged. Tickets for manual replays assigned to eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Incident update: INC-20260322-1140  owners: eng-oncall, cs-ops  status: mitigated  sla-impact: onboarding write failures for subset of EU tenants.

diego_eng: Can we add a single sentence to the customer note: "We do not expect permanent data loss; we are reprocessing incomplete writes and will coordinate any remaining replays with you."

amy_csm: Done. Ill send the comms at 14:15 UTC and post to the customer status page. Priya, please follow up with your renewal accounts after the mail goes out.

priya_ae: Will do. Ill schedule 1:1 remediation calls for my five affected renewal accounts and add notes in Gainsight.

amy_csm: Thanks team. Closing the thread after send. :thumbsup:
